past_24h.text: Over the past 24 hours, the Portland gauge reached 11.41 ft MLLW around Thu, Nov 26 at 11:48 AM ET, 0.59 ft below the 12.0 ft Minor Flood threshold. Marine observations: 44007 gusted to 47.0 mph; WEXM1 reached 12.8 mph sustained. Portland water reached +1.74 ft above the predicted astronomical tide around Fri, Nov 27 at 2:48 AM ET. The latest sustained wind at NOAA/NDBC offshore buoy 44007 was 29.1 mph, rose from 8.9 mph in the compatible snapshot nearest 24 hours earlier. The latest wind gust at NOAA/NDBC offshore buoy 44007 was 35.8 mph, rose from 11.2 mph in the compatible snapshot nearest 24 hours earlier. The latest offshore significant wave height at NOAA/NDBC offshore buoy 44007 was 12.5 ft, rose from 1.3 ft in the compatible snapshot nearest 24 hours earlier. This offshore buoy reading is not a local surf measurement. The latest barometric pressure at NOAA/NDBC offshore buoy 44007 was 1007.8 mb, fell from 1040.6 mb in the compatible snapshot nearest 24 hours earlier.
